local_articles.title: Singapore’s Gan Ching Hwee wins historic 1,500m freestyle silver at Asian Games
local_articles.snippet: 4) and 800m freestyle (Sept 25). At the last Games, Singapore bagged just one swimming medal through Teong Tzen Wei’s men’s 50m butterfly silver. Earlier in the swim meet, China’s 13-year-old prodigy Yu Zidi set a Games record when she won the women’s 200m butterfly final in 2:05.08, ahead of teammate Chang Mohan (2:08.44) and Japan’s Misa Okuzono (2:09.67). The teenager shaved almost half a second off compatriot Zhang Yufei’s mark of 2:05.57 set in 2023. The home crowd had much to cheer about in a thrilling men’s 200m individual medley final when Japan’s lone Paris 2024 swimming medallist Tomoyuki Matsushita pipped teammate Yumeki Kojima by 0.06sec to win in 1:55.30. China’s defending champion Wang Shun was third in 1:57.14. Singapore’s Reagen Cheng set a personal best of 2:01.25 in the morning heats, shaving almost a second off his previous best of 2:02.11, and finished 10th in 2:02.65

priority_updates.title: Who will be the first person charged in the United Kingdom over alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official public charging announcement from the United Kingdom’s Crown Prosecution Service. Resolution : Identify the first individual formally charged in the United Kingdom in connection with alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, provided the charges are announced by December 31, 2026. Arrests without charges, extradition proceedings, and charges brought outside the United Kingdom do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.

priority_updates.title: Which former minister from Viktor Orban's government, if any, will have parliamentary immunity lifted in September 2026 to permit an embezzlement investigation?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Hungarian parliamentary records or contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations identifying former ministers whose immunity is lifted. Qualifying Event : Hungary's Parliament must vote during September 2026 to remove a former Orban-government minister's immunity specifically to allow prosecutors to pursue an embezzlement investigation. Allegations alone, without the parliamentary vote, do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the former minister's full name. If no former minister qualifies during September 2026, resolve as no qualifying minister.

priority_updates.title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?

Resolution : Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins. Accepted Answer Format : The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.
